content.title: When does 'Euphoria' season 3 come out? All about its release date, time jump, and many new cast members
content.text: Euphoria season 3 premieres on April 12. Season 3 will jump forward in time, exploring the characters' lives after high school.Zendaya, Hunter Schafer, Sydney Sweeney, and Jacob Elordi are among the cast members returning for the season. Zendaya was the brightest star on Euphoria when it debuted back in 2019, but the scandalous HBO drama served as a launchpad for several members of its supporting cast. Despite the rising profiles of Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, Maude Apatow, and Colman Domingo, the ensemble has reunited for Euphoria's long-gestating third season, which was first announced over four years ago. Whether or not the season would actually surface has been a topic of fascination these last several years, so fans were relieved when HBO announced an April 12 premiere date and released a string of trailers. Below is everything we know about Euphoria season 3. Will there be a season 3 of Euphoria? Hunter Schafer as Jules in 'Euphoria' season 3. HBO Yes, Euphoria will return for season 3, but we can understand why so many folks thought it was doomed. In early 2024, rumors that the series was kaput swirled online, prompting HBO to release a statement that season 3 was still on the way. “HBO and Sam Levinson remain committed to making an exceptional third season,” a spokesperson told Entertainment Weekly at the time. “In the interim, we are allowing our in-demand cast to pursue other opportunities.” That "in-demand cast also expressed confusion and uncertainty about the series' future. When Jimmy Fallon asked Elordi when the show could return during a January 2024 appearance on The Tonight Show, Elordi replied, "I don’t know, do you know?” Elordi joked, “I hope it’s soon, or they’re going to have to Benjamin Button me or something. I’m going to have a bad back walking down the hallway, you know?” Nika King, who plays the mother of Rue (Zendaya), joked that the delays were impacting her personally. "Don't ask me [when season 3 is coming out]. I don't f---ing know," she said in a stand-up set posted on her TikTok account. "People are like, 'We need season 3,' and I'm like, bitch, I need season 3! I haven’t paid my rent in six months." Chloe Cherry, the actress who played Faye in season 2, told The Daily Mail in 2024 that she, too, was unaware of the show's plans. "No one talks to me. They really don't talk to me," she said. "I would definitely go back, but they just leave me in the dark, let's just say that." In February 2025, HBO confirmed that production had begun, and even offered proof of life with a still of Zendaya's Rue from season 3. “Sam, Zendaya, and the entire cast and crew of Euphoria have taken season 2 to extraordinary heights, challenging narrative convention and form while maintaining its heart," said Francesca Orsi, executive vice president of HBO programming, in a statement. "We couldn’t be more honored to work with this gifted, wildly talented team or more excited to continue our journey with them into season 3.“ Is there a Euphoria season 3 release date? Zendaya and Dominic Fike on 'Euphoria'. Eddy Chen/HBO Yes, Euphoria season 3 will premiere on April 12. What is Euphoria season 3 about? Alexa Demie as Maddy in 'Euphoria' season 3. HBO The trim logline for Euphoria season 3 reads, "A group of childhood friends wrestle with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption, and the problem of evil." In the summer of 2023, creator Sam Levinson described season 3 as a "film noir," adding that Rue's journey would allow the season to "explore what it means to be an individual with principles in a corrupt world." While promoting her film Challengers in 2024, Zendaya confirmed to EW that the upcoming season would feature a time jump. "It's important because there's only so much high school drama you can deal with," she told us. We now know that the series jumps ahead five years, and that Rue is wrapped up in a dicey situation involving a drug kingpin played by Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, the debt she (still) owes dealer Laurie (Martha Kelly), and the Drug Enforcement Administration. Zendaya as Rue in 'Euphoria' season 3. HBO Elsewhere, Cassie (Sweeney) is engaged to Nate (Elordi) and making OnlyFans content. During an HBO Max presentation in December, Levinson revealed she's "very addicted to social media and envious of what appears to be the big lives that all of her high school classmates are living at this point in time." Jules (Hunter Schafer) is in art school and, according to Levinson, "very nervous about having a career as a painter and trying to avoid responsibility at all costs." Maddy (Alexa Demie) and Lexi (Apatow) are both living in Hollywood, with Maddy working for a talent agency and Lexi serving as the assistant to a showrunner played by Sharon Stone. Domingo spoke to the thrust of the season in an interview with British GQ in 2024. "[Levinson is] a person who writes and rewrites and writes and rewrites again, because I think he's wrestling with what’s important," the actor said. "He's responding immediately to what the ills of the world are. I know that the one thing I can tell you is that he's very much interested in the existential question of who we are right now. Our souls. That's what he wants to figure out with season three." Is there a trailer for Euphoria season 3? There are two trailers, each offering a look at the core ensemble's chaotic lives and the multitude of guest performers rounding out the season. "A few years after high school, I don't know if life was exactly what I wished," Rue narrates in the first trailer, which arrived in January. "And yet somehow, for the first time, I was beginning to have faith." As Rue finds herself strung between various underworld figures, her sponsor Ali (Domingo) tells her to "have faith," leading to what looks like a spiritual journey for Rue. But she ponders at the concept of salvation: "You make a deal with the Devil, and there's no turning back." Meanwhile, we see Maddy declaring how every girl in her orbit is a "sugar baby," and Nate lamenting how he works all day only to come home to see his "bride-to-be is spread-eagled on the internet." The second trailer, released on March 30, reveals that the DEA is also wrapped up in Rue's season 3 saga. They see her a "good kid in a bad situation." It also shows Maddy helping Cassie with her online modeling, Jules reuniting with Cal (Eric Dane), and Nate being terrorized by some shady characters. "In the end, no matter who you are or what you want, we all answer to God," Rue says as the trailer comes to a close. Which cast members are returning for Euphoria season 3? Sydney Sweeney as Cassie in 'Euphoria' season 3. HBO In addition to the core cast, the season will also see the return of the following cast members: Alanna Ubach (Suze)Daeg Faerch (Mitch)Dominic Fike (Elliot)Melvin Bonez Estes (Bruce)Paula Marshall (Marsha)Sophia Rose Wilson (BB)Zak Steiner (Aaron)Nika King (Leslie)Chloe Cherry (Faye) Not returning for season 3 are Barbie Ferreira, who starred as Kat Hernandez, and Storm Reid, who played Rue's sister Gia. Angus Cloud, who was a key player in the first two seasons as Fezco, died in 2023 at the age of 25. Will Eric Dane be in Euphoria season 3? Eric Dane as Cal in 'Euphoria' season 2. Eddy Chen/HBO As Cal, Nate's abusive father, Grey's Anatomy alum Eric Dane emerged as one of the strangest and most striking characters on Euphoria. After revealing he'd been diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in early 2025, the actor died in February 2026, but not before filming scenes for the third season. HBO shared a statement honoring Dane following his death. "We are deeply saddened by the news of Eric Dane’s passing. He was incredibly talented and HBO was fortunate to have worked with him on three seasons of Euphoria. Our thoughts are with his loved ones during this difficult time." Who's joining the Euphoria season 3 cast? Sharon Stone in 'Euphoria' season 3. HBO Earlier in 2025, it was announced that Oscar nominee Sharon Stone, Super Bowl champ Marshawn Lynch, and Grammy-winning pop star Rosalía would appear in Euphoria season 3. Also announced at the time were Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje (Lost), Toby Wallace (The Bikeriders), Asante Blackk (When They See Us), Darrell Britt-Gibson (The Wire), Priscilla Delgado (A League of Their Own), Kadeem Hardison (A Different World), James Landry Hébert (1883), and Anna Van Patten (Gossip Girl). Rosalía in 'Euphoria' season 3. Courtesy of HBO In October 2025, HBO announced even more stars lined up for season 3. They include Poker Face star Natasha Lyonne, horror director Eli Roth, award-winning Till actress Danielle Deadwyler, True Blood's Sam Trammell, and YouTube maven Trisha Paytas. They'll be joined by numerous other guest stars, including Bella Podaras (Ashley Garcia: Genius in Love), Bill Bodner (Killer Psyche), Cailyn Rice (1923), Colleen Camp (Clue), Gideon Adlon (Sick), Hemky Madera (Spider-Man: Homecoming), Homer Gere (August), Jack Topalian (True Detective), Jessica Blair Herman (9-1-1), Kwame Patterson (The Wire), Madison Thompson (Ozark), Matthew Willig (Young Rock), and Rebecca Pidgeon (Bird Box). Where can I watch Euphoria? Euphoria is available to stream on HBO Max. Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter.
